name: qazaq-tas
description: QAZAQ TAS GROUP — единая цифровая ERP-система производственной компании

scripts.postinstall: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @qazaq-tas/shared
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @qazaq-tas/shared" "npm run dev -w @qazaq-tas/api" "npm run dev -w @qazaq-tas/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @qazaq-tas/shared && npm run build -w @qazaq-tas/api && npm run build -w @qazaq-tas/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w @qazaq-tas/api" "npm run start -w @qazaq-tas/web"
